subject: PayNova security onboarding: IR plan, access logs, and SIG/CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@paynova.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: security@paynova.com
Date: Fri, 04 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PayNova security onboarding: IR plan, access logs, and SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Jonas,

We're kicking off security onboarding for the planned PayNova integration and confirming a few artifacts we need to close risk review this week. Can you share the items below (or an expected delivery timeline) and the secure upload method you prefer?

Request (priority order):
- Current Incident Response Plan (IRP) and on-call escalation matrix (redacted ok)
- Completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ crosswalk for high-level gaps
- Sample telemetry/log export (sanitized) that includes request_id, timestamp, model_id, action, status_code, and source network fingerprint (src_ip may be redacted)
- Confirmation of data retention windows and retention/archival policy for customer logs
- Evidence of SOC 2 controls relevant to incident detection/response (audit artifacts or mapping)

We're a payments platform; our compliance team needs these artifacts to complete our vendor assessment. Ideally we can get a secure upload link and the IRP + SIG by EOD PT today, and the sanitized log export within 24 hours after. If any of this requires a narrow NDA or a data access agreement, please flag and we can get that signed this morning.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if that's easier.

Alex Torres
Head of Trust & Safety
PayNova
security@paynova.com

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (Security) and Karthik (IR lead) to own artifacts and upload. Quick plan:

1) IRP + escalation matrix (redacted) and draft SIG answers: attaching PDF/XLSX stubs. We will publish these to a shared, access-controlled Drive link below by EOD PT.
2) Sanitized telemetry sample: we can produce a one-day extract with fields you listed, redacting src_ip to /24 and removing any PII. We will provide via secure SFTP or temporary pre-signed object — whichever you prefer.
3) SOC 2 mapping: we'll include the SOC 2 ID and mapping snippets relevant to detection & response; for a full audit package we typically require an NDA or transient access request (we'll include a short Data Access Agreement template).

Proposed timeline: IRP + SIG draft by 18:00 PT today; sanitized telemetry via secure upload by 11:00 PT tomorrow (May 5). If you need faster delivery on logs, confirm SFTP and we'll prioritize.

Drive (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/PayNova-evidence-pack
SFTP path (placeholder): sftp://sftp.redwood.ai/paynova/onboarding/

Attachments: Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf (redacted), SIG_Response_PayNova.xlsx (draft)

Alex — thanks for the patience. A few clarifications from the security operations side to make the telemetry export useful for your reviewers:

- Fields we'll include in the sanitized sample (CSV): timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, model_id, tenant_id (hashed), action, status_code, latency_ms, event_type, geo_region, src_ip_redacted (CIDR /24).
- We will NOT include user-generated content or raw prompt text in the export; those are excluded for privacy. If you need example de-identified prompts for QA, we can provide synthetic samples.
- Retention and discovery: default retention for request logs is 90 days; for onboarding evidence we can provide a 30-day extract and a one-time snapshot for your archive.
- Evidence delivery: we'll upload artifacts to the Drive link Jonas provided and place the sanitized logs on the SFTP path. Credentials will be shared via 1Password secure note (I will send the access link to the PayNova security mailbox only).
- Redaction & attestations: attached is an evidence_manifest_template.csv you can use to confirm what we uploaded; we will also include a short attestation statement for the sanitized export.

We also recommend executing a short Data Access Agreement (two paragraphs) before we upload any logs that include src_ip_redacted; I have attached a DocuSign-ready link (internal) and can send the PayNova-facing link once you confirm.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv, Redwood_IRP_v2.1.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
